searchText: Is there a place that tracks the number of active validator clients? https://beaconcha.in/validators#active That's the list of all validators, but not validator clients You mean the ratio of Prysm to Teku to etc.? No I mean the number of *clients* running for ETH2.0. It's my understanding that multiple validators can use the same validator clients for instance. validator clients are not connected to the internet though beacon nodes are, so you'd only be able to get statistics of those.. and then maybe guess how many validators are attached to a certain beacon node (but could be multiple) I see. And is there a place tracking the number of beacon nodes? I don't think there are that many crawlers for the beacon chain yet, maybe for privacy reasons as well I don't think it's possible to find that number
